mentions.name: SummitWind
mentions.description: A mountaineering safety tool providing summit-level wind forecasts for 16 mountaineering objectives including Rainier, Whitney, Denali, Mont Blanc, and the Matterhorn. In browsers with WebGPU, it solves the wind field live as a compute shader (about 35 ms on an Apple GPU) as the timeline is scrubbed and draws the flow over a 3D terrain view; browsers without WebGPU get a precomputed field. Forecasts show ranges and uncertainty only, with no go/no-go verdicts. A planned free-play mode will let users set wind direction and speed themselves and watch the field re-solve.
mentions.audience: Mountaineers; built by the author for themselves and their friends
mentions.source_excerpt:
